# Marketing skill pack

Skills for brand, positioning, content, campaigns, SEO, email, social, events, launches and performance measurement. Built for small marketing teams who need to produce good work quickly and stay on the right side of EU consumer, privacy and AI transparency rules.

**21 skills** · version 1.1.0 · EU and Denmark aware · works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot (chat and code).

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install marketing-skills --marketplace gifmaster/department-skills`
- Install anywhere else: see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)
- Each skill folder has `SKILL.md` (for platforms that load skills) and `PROMPT.md` (copy-paste instructions for custom GPTs, Gems and Copilot agents).

## Suggested workflows

Skills work on their own, and chain well in these sequences.

### Foundations
Who we serve, what we stand for and how we sound.

`mkt-positioning-messaging` → `mkt-persona-builder` → `mkt-brand-voice-guide` → `mkt-customer-journey-map`
### Campaign
From brief to live campaign to results.

`mkt-campaign-brief` → `mkt-content-calendar` → `mkt-ad-copy-variants` → `mkt-landing-page-copy` → `mkt-email-newsletter` → `mkt-performance-report`
### Content engine
Search-led content repurposed across channels.

`mkt-seo-keyword-brief` → `mkt-article-writer` → `mkt-social-post-pack` → `mkt-case-study-writer`

## Built-in guardrails

- Write in the brand's voice and avoid generic, AI-sounding phrases and filler. Prefer concrete facts, examples and plain words.
- Do not invent statistics, testimonials, reviews, customer names or awards. Use placeholders and ask the user for evidence behind every factual or comparative claim.
- Respect privacy and consumer rules in campaigns, including consent for tracking and email, honest pricing claims and clear advertising identification.

## Regulatory facts

Every skill in this pack ships `references/facts.md`: dated, sourced figures and rules (last verified 2026-11-17). The master copy is [facts/marketing.md](../../facts/marketing.md). Update it there and rebuild.

These notes are orientation, not legal advice. Check current law, collective agreements and your own policies.
